briefdescription.para: Per-IP abuse detector combining static lists with sliding-window request counting.

detaileddescription.para: This header declares DOSDetector, a class that decides whether an incoming request should be allowed, is on a whitelist/blacklist, or is part of abusive traffic. It counts recent requests per IP address and per "fingerprint" (a hash of the request's headers and body) inside a moving time window. Too many different fingerprints means "rate limited"; too many repeats of one fingerprint means "banned". A background thread periodically removes counters and blocks that have expired.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: This is the defence against denial-of-service and brute-force traffic. A Drogon filter (Filters::RateLimit) captures each request and calls GateKeeper::isDosAttack, which forwards to this detector's is_dos_attack(). Based on the returned Status the filter either lets the request through or sends an error. The detector is one shared object in Store, so all request threads see the same counters. Without it the server would have no way to notice or slow an attacker flooding it with requests.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
Mutex/lock (protecting shared data from simultaneous threads): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/thread/mutex
Condition variable (a thread sleeping until told to wake): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/thread/condition_variable
std::async / std::future (running a task in the background): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/thread/async
std::atomic (a variable safe to read/write from many threads): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/atomic/atomic
Sliding window / rate limiting: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rate_limiting
Denial-of-service attack: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Denial-of-service_attack
Hash function (turning data into a fixed-size number): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hash_function
xxHash (the fast hash used here): https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash
Regular expression: https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/regex
CIDR notation (IP address + network prefix): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Classless_Inter-Domain_Routing
